goals.description: Add one new deterministic regression test in tests/test_checkout_recovery_1465.py. It calls the real `_git` helper and reads the effective Git config with `config --list`. It uses an observer that exits 0 when the keys are unset. It asserts that the output has `maintenance.auto=false` and `gc.auto=0`. The assertion message is exactly: `_git must run every Git call with maintenance.auto=false and gc.auto=0`. On base it fails by assertion, not by CalledProcessError. It uses no sleeps, no elapsed-time checks and no probabilistic loops.

Change the `_git` helper in tests/test_checkout_recovery_1465.py. Every Git call must disable automatic maintenance and gc, for example with `-c maintenance.auto=false -c gc.auto=0`. Keep GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL and GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM isolation. The `wrong-head` commit must stay compatible with its own `-c user.name` and `-c user.email` arguments.

Keep the exact archive, provenance and original-tree-preservation security assertions. Keep all 23 fault parameters of the existing test. Add no skips, xfail, retries or widened deadlines. Do not change `tarfile` handling. Do not relax snapshot or provenance comparisons.

Edit only tests/test_checkout_recovery_1465.py. Do not edit production materializer code, routing, budgets, quarantine or any other test. Do not hand-edit generated BUILD files. If regeneration is needed, use the configured generator.

Produce independent run_tests evidence for tests/test_checkout_recovery_1465.py. Run it at base and at head. The new regression test must fail by assertion at base, with the old `_git` helper unchanged, and pass at head. Record each run's own verdict, log, skips and missing tools. Print only allowlisted status, returncode, hashes, sizes and timestamps.

Produce contention evidence. Run run_tests on tests/test_checkout_recovery_1465.py with repeat=10 and parallel=4, twice at base and twice at head, through normal PrismaBuild admission. This evidence is supporting only. It is not the RED proof. A zero-symptom base run is not RED. Report the observed results honestly.

Open a non-draft PR from the TL3 branch for issue #2710. The body has `Refs #2710`, exactly one `Change type: test` line, and the run_tests base/head evidence. Do not queue, merge, label, restart requests, publish a runtime, or change host configuration. An independent Sol review is required before the migration lead queues it. Do not rename an open PR branch.
